hotel_name: Anantara Convento di Amalfi Grand Hotel

claims.text: The hotel was originally a 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside.

findings.quote: a 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside

claims.text: It overlooks the harbour, 600 metres from the Amalfi town centre.

findings.quote: is built into the cliffside overlooking the harbour, just 600 m from the town centre

claims.text: The hotel sits 80 metres above the sea, with views over Amalfi and the Gulf of Salerno.

findings.quote: From this cliffside-carved eyrie 80 metres above the sea, the whole of picaresque, rollicking
and the glistening waters of the Gulf of Salerno are laid out in panorama

claims.text: The convent became a hotel in 1882.

findings.quote: in 1882, by which time the culture of the European Grand Tour amongst wealthy British and North American youth of rank had peaked, the convent finally transmogrified into a hotel

claims.text: The rooms were originally the monks' quarters.

findings.quote: Originally the monks’ quarters, these accommodations maintain their solemn simplicity

claims.text: Almost all rooms and suites look directly out to sea.

findings.quote: Almost all of our 52 suites and rooms look directly out to sea.

claims.text: A long loggia laden with bougainvillea, the Passeggiata dei Monaci, runs along the terraces.

findings.quote: under the long, lazy loggia laden with vibrant fuschia bougainvillaea – the Passeggiata dei Monaci

claims.text: A twelfth-century chapel on site is used for weddings.

findings.quote: XII century chapel for weddings

claims.text: The swimming pool and gym are located on the cliffside.

findings.quote: has a spectacular swimming pool and gym located on the cliffside

claims.text: The hotel has an Anantara Spa.

findings.quote: There is also the award-winning Anantara Spa.

claims.text: There are two restaurants: Dei Cappuccini, the main restaurant, and La Locanda della Canonica, for an informal outdoor lunch.

findings.quote: Dei Cappuccini, the main restaurant, and La Locanda della Canonica, ideal for an informal outdoor lunch

claims.text: Chef Claudio Lanuto uses seasonal ingredients grown in the convent garden.

findings.quote: chef Claudio Lanuto utilises seasonal ingredients grown in the “convent garden”

claims.text: The heated infinity pool is available all season.

findings.quote: Heated infinity pool available all season

claims.text: Suites offer options such as a private terrace with a jacuzzi, views of the cloisters, or a standalone suite in the lemon grove.

findings.quote: Opt for a private terrace with a jacuzzi, views of the cloisters, or a standalone suite in the lemon grove.

claims.text: Behind the monastery-hermitage is part of the old Arab-Norman cloister, colonnaded with interlaced arches.

findings.quote: Tucked behind the historic 13th-century monastery-hermitage, like a secret, is part of the old Arab-Norman cloister, collonaded with interlaced arches

claims.text: The hotel works with a Franciscan friar from Ravello who introduces guests to the chapel or takes them on tours of Ravello.

findings.quote: The hotel works with a local Franciscan friar from Ravello, Friar Marcus, to introduce interested guests to the chapel, or whisk them on tours of Ravello

claims.text: Guests have access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club, five minutes away by boat.

findings.quote: offers access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club which is five minutes away by boat

claims.text: The hotel is on the cliffside rather than on the beach; the Lido degli Artisti beach club is reached by boat and charges apply.

findings.quote: is built into the cliffside overlooking the harbour
offers access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club which is five minutes away by boat. Please note that charges apply.

claims.text: The historic building has many steps in different directions, though lifts reach every level.

findings.quote: with any number of steps going in multiple different directions, does not initially scream accessibility, but there are three accessible rooms and lifts accessing every level

claims.text: The hotel is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Naples International Airport.

findings.quote: is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Naples International Airport
